observed_ids: list[int], predicted visible normative instance IDs
event_order: list[int] or null when actual history unobservable; never fill from normative G
active_id: int or -1 when no unique currently observed moving stroke; -1 does not imply pen lift
progress: per-instance continuous geometric fraction, raw regression
geometry_state: per-instance 0 absent / 1 partial / 2 full, independently classified
stroke_start: per-instance start event since previous observation
stroke_complete: per-instance newly reached geometric coverage, not a pen-up event
direction: per-instance unknown / forward / reverse relative to normative reference direction
observation_confidence: predicted observability of actual order, not probability that the particular order answer is correct
pen_lift_evidence: unknown in D0 with no visible pen tip
decision: D output first_error (0-based event position) / error_type / next_legal (normative ID) / action
decision_fusion: D uses geometry_state mapped to0/partial<.985/full1; raw progress is reported separately. Inconsistency is retained for diagnosis.
h2_status: Draft interface only; not reliable enough to drive autonomous generation. Extra/missing strokes and more than16 reference instances not validated.
